editorialPolicy.title: Editorial & Listing Standards
editorialPolicy.intro_text: Cataito is an independent, hand-curated directory. Every tool is reviewed before it is listed, and we keep listings under ongoing review. Our goal is a catalog you can trust: we prioritize genuinely useful, safe, and honestly-marketed AI tools, and we decline or remove those that put users at risk. The standards below describe exactly how we decide what stays.
editorialPolicy.reject_text: A tool is refused listing — or removed if already listed — when any of the following applies:
reject_items: Billing fraud: deceptive charges, undisclosed auto-renewal, refusal to cancel or refund, or a documented pattern of billing complaints.
Malware or unsafe distribution: bundled malware, browser hijacking, or unsafe installers/extensions.
Collapsed reputation: a consistent, well-documented pattern of user harm across independent sources.
Impersonation or counterfeiting: fake clones or tools that misrepresent their identity, ownership, or capabilities.
Fraud-enabling by design: tools whose primary purpose is deception or abuse (e.g. scam-oriented face/voice cloning, non-consensual imagery).
Privacy black boxes: no discernible privacy policy, or handling of user data in clearly abusive ways.
Dead product: the service is discontinued, abandoned, or no longer reachable.
editorialPolicy.watch_text: Some tools are listed but capped — we cap their rating and disclose the concern openly in the tool's pros & cons — when we see:
watch_items: Excessive or intrusive advertising that degrades the experience.
A past controversy that has since been addressed (kept under observation).
Research-preview or waitlist-only status with limited public availability.
An ownership or acquisition change that we note transparently.
Opaque pricing that makes real costs hard to determine upfront.
editorialPolicy.evidence_text: We do not act on rumor. A red-line judgment requires corroboration from at least two independent, recent sources — such as consumer-protection records, established review platforms, or substantiated first-hand reports — before a tool is rejected or removed.
editorialPolicy.review_text: Listing is not permanent. We periodically re-check live status and pricing automatically, and we re-audit existing listings for reputation and safety over time. When a tool crosses a red line, we remove it regardless of how long it has been listed.
editorialPolicy.report_text: Found a listed tool that violates these standards? Tell us and we will investigate. Contact us at:

about.metaTitle: About Cataito — Independent AI Tools Directory
about.metaDescription: Cataito is an independent, multilingual portal for the AI ecosystem. Learn who we are, how we curate and verify AI tools, and how to reach us.
about.title: About Cataito
about.subtitle: An independent guide to the AI ecosystem
about.missionText1: New AI tools launch every week, and picking the right one has never been harder. Cataito exists to cut through the noise: we curate, verify and explain the AI tools that actually matter, so you can decide in minutes instead of hours.
about.missionText2: Cataito is available in five languages — English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and French — because the AI ecosystem is global and language should never be the barrier.
about.whatText: Cataito currently covers {count} AI tools across 16 categories. Everything is free to browse — no account required.
whatItems: A curated AI tool directory spanning chat, image, code, video, audio, agents, developer platforms and more
In-depth tool pages with key features, pricing, pros & cons, supported platforms and step-by-step tutorials
A Skill Marketplace for AI agent skills with live GitHub star counts
A blog covering major AI industry news and hands-on guides
about.methodText: Accuracy beats completeness. These are the editorial principles behind every page:
methodItems: Facts such as pricing and platform support are checked against official sources — product websites, documentation and release notes
If something cannot be confirmed through an official channel, we mark it as unknown and hide it rather than guess
Editorial verdicts are written by humans and kept clearly separate from factual data — we do not publish made-up scores
Discontinued products stay listed with a clear label, so you never waste time on a dead tool
Listings are reviewed and updated regularly as products evolve
about.independenceText: Cataito is run by a small independent editorial team. We do not sell placements, and no vendor can pay to influence a listing or a verdict — inclusion is always an editorial decision.
about.contactText: Found an error, want to recommend a tool, or just want to say hello? We read every message.
